title.en: Selection of first human ESD lesions

description.en: Correct case selection for the first 20 human ESD procedures: <30 mm, located in the antrum or rectum (never the colon). Recognises unsuitable lesions (colon, scarring, ulceration, high SMI risk).

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for selection of first human esd lesions but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs selection of first human esd lesions independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches selection of first human esd lesions to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
